Title: Azure Storage is in the Preview Portal

Body.Content:
Azure Storage is now part of the preview portal. Use it to:
  • create a new storage account with a unique name and account type.
  • view the list of all your storage containers, tables and queues by clicking on their respective parts. You can manage containers right now, and we'll be adding support for managing tables and queues soon.
  • access your storage keys using the Keys part (you can find it in the Overview lens), and regenerate your storage account keys whenever you need to. Check out Properties for a view of all of your storage info in one place.
  • view storage metrics using the Monitoring lens, and keep track of your account's performance and usage.
